description: Verify that the Solicited OfferService Type 1 entry IndexFirstOptionRun of the notification is 0
approach:
[Objective]
This case asserts a single SOME/IP-SD wire-format invariant: Solicited OfferService Type 1 entry IndexFirstOptionRun must equal 0. The harness drives DUT to emit a qualifying notification, captures it, and validates the field byte-precisely.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester drives DUT to emit a notification (typically by completing OfferService prelude or sending a stimulus message).
2. Observation: captured notification's Solicited OfferService Type 1 entry IndexFirstOptionRun == 0   ← key check

[Pass condition]
Solicited OfferService Type 1 entry IndexFirstOptionRun on the wire equals 0.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_index_first — Entry IndexFirstOptionRun nonzero
• Fail_timeout — DUT did not emit a qualifying notification within the listen window

verdicts.Pass: DUT-emitted Solicited OfferService Type 1 entry IndexFirstOptionRun == 0 — normal
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No qualifying notification within listen window
